profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer @ Intuit | Child/Adolescent Mental Health Advocate @ Hillside
profile.summary:
I build AI systems that actually ship and I'm obsessed with making them trustworthy, fast, and useful at scale.

Over 12 years, I've grown from fullstack engineer to designing systems that merge AI, data, and user experience into something people actually rely on. Most recently at Intuit Mailchimp, I built agentic AI workflows that cut a project's delivery time 8x. I built the recommendation engine and In-Product Discovery targeting platform, and wrote the governance playbooks that made those systems auditable and safe for multi-team adoption.

I care about the 'boring' parts of AI: explainability, hallucination prevention, structured outputs, audibility. 

On the platform side, I've architected RAG pipelines on AWS Bedrock, built vector search with pgvector, and enforced JSON-LD schemas across agentic workflows to keep LLM outputs safe for downstream systems. At AWS ProServe, I helped enterprise customers ship cloud infrastructure at scale.

Outside of work, I serve on the board of Hillside, a nonprofit supporting children's mental health - applying my systems-thinking to help therapists and patients get better tools.

Currently open to my next chapter in AI platform engineering.
📍 Atlanta, GA | remote / hybrid

positions.title: Front End Developer
positions.description:
As the first frontend engineer hired to the South East ProServe team I helped define
the role for working on client projects. I work with clients to provide developer
training sessions, as well as frontend architectural guidance to ensure applications
run fast and are scalable.
- Developed an order management application (React) that saved a client
5,700 hours of manual data entry per year, as well as save on product loss.
- Developed an iPad (React Native) application for a client in the healthcare industry
to help with more efficient patient routing that leads to an increase in health
outcomes.
- Created best practices standards for frontend devs at ProServe to follow.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) · Full-Stack Development

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer – Industry 4.0 team
positions.description:
The Industry 4.0 team located in SBD's Digital Accelerator in Atlanta is tasked with
bringing SBD's hundreds of manufacturing plants into the future with adding sensors
to manufacturing lines, setting up APIs, for streamlined data reporting, data analytics,
augmented reality, and easier plant configurations.
- Developed apps in Vue and Node Lambdas to be used on the manufacturing plant
floors and for Plant Managers to use for monitoring and reporting.
- Developed Global Plant Landing App using D3 and Vue that shows the live statuses
of connected plants in real-time.
- Help architect data schemas and data flows for our applications, and normalize
different data types for thousands of manufactured products for our plants.

projects.title: Fittr
projects.description:
Fittr is a web application that allows users to compare fitness metrics with the world, across a wide range of quantified self devices.

The application was built using the MEAN stack, and uses popular libraries and tools such as Mongoose, D3, NVD3
